veni.translation: came,I saw,I conquered, 恺撒大帝

venial.definition:
s warranting only temporal punishment
s easily excused or forgiven
venial.translation:
a. 可原谅的, 可宽恕的, 轻微的
[法] 可宽恕的, 可原谅的, 轻微的

veniality.definition: n. The quality or state of being venial; venialness.
veniality.translation:
n. 可宽恕性
[法] 可宽恕的, 可宽宥

venice.definition: n. the provincial capital of Veneto; built on 118 islands within a lagoon in the Gulf of Venice; has canals instead of streets; one of Italy's major ports and a famous tourist attraction

venice treacle.translation: [医] 威尼斯糖蜜, 安德罗马库斯氏解毒糖剂

venice turpenting.translation: [医] 威尼斯松脂, 落叶松脂

venipuncture.definition: n. (medicine) puncture of a vein through the skin in order to withdraw blood for analysis or to start an intravenous drip or to inject medication or a radiopaque dye
venipuncture.translation:
n. 静脉穿刺
[医] 静脉穿刺术

venire.definition: n (law) a group of people summoned for jury service (from whom a jury will be chosen)

venire facias.definition:
A judicial writ or precept directed to the sheriff,
   requiring him to cause a certain number of qualified persons to appear
   in court at a specified time, to serve as jurors in said court.
 A writ in the nature of a summons to cause the party
   indicted on a penal statute to appear. Called also venire.

venison.definition: n. meat from a deer used as food

veniss.translation: abbr. Visual Education National Information Service for Schools 学校可视教育的国家信息服务中心

venit et defendit.translation: [法] 前来辩护, 出庭辩护

venite.definition:
n. The 95th Psalm, which is said or sung regularly in the
   public worship of many churches. Also, a musical composition adapted to
   this Psalm.
venite.translation: n. [宗]赞美诗篇,晨祷诗篇,赞美诗乐曲,晨祷诗乐曲
